parts.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Not the Same Business
AI Lenders Are Financing the End of Scarcity

mentions.excerpt: Geo Chen says cheap intelligence is already eroding the labs’ share and access to capital.
Geo Chen, who exited AI positions in June, wrote in September that only one bearish scenario had arrived: token prices fell as cheaper open and Chinese models took share.
